name: measures-health
description: measures-health CLI surface. Single source of truth for the `validate` and `search` domains: schema-validated against cli-manifest/v1 and cross-validated against the ScenarioValidationService/ValidationService/SearchService proto descriptors at test time. Loaded by cli/main.go via cliapp.LoadFromManifest.

groups.name: validate
groups.description: Validate scenario measure coverage and grade adoption

commands.name: scenario
commands.description: Grade a scenario's measure coverage (expected/covered/waived) and optionally probe its declared measures end-to-end

flags.name: probe
flags.description: Run the behavioral adoption probe against live measure endpoints

commands.name: coverage
commands.description: Roll up measure coverage across every discovered scenario (the fleet view)

groups.name: search
groups.description: Query the central measures index (the federated measures provider)

commands.name: query
commands.description: Match an analytical question to a measure and return the computed answer (the search-hub measure provider)

flags.name: limit
flags.description: Maximum number of measure hits to return

groups.name: measures
groups.description: measures-health's own declared analytical measures over its validation_run history (the gold-star dogfood)

commands.name: failed
commands.description: Count scenarios that failed measures validation in a window

flags.name: window
flags.description: Time window token (this_week, last_7d, last_30d, this_month, last_month, this_quarter)

measure.intent: How many scenarios failed measures validation in a time window.
questions: how many scenarios failed measures validation this week
how many scenarios failed the measures gate in the last 7 days

commands.name: coverage
commands.description: Count scenarios that passed measures validation in a window (fleet measure-coverage over time)

flags.name: window
flags.description: Time window token (this_week, last_7d, last_30d, this_month, last_month, this_quarter)

measure.intent: How many scenarios passed measures validation in a time window.
questions: how many scenarios passed measures validation this week
how many scenarios had clean measures validation in the last 30 days
